findings.desc: Active host/capability runtime still exports Authority receipt/server completion semantics after Authority Server retirement. packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:63-66 hard-codes authorityRules.productionDoneRequiresReceipt=true and receiptCapability="receipt-verify"; capabilities.ts:125-135 describes submitting signed evidence to an external authority service and verifying an authority receipt before production completion; capabilities.ts:338-350 keeps a Server profile with receipt verification available. packages/main/src/core/lattice-hosts.ts:354-357 tells users production completion still requires a verified authority receipt, and lattice-autopilot.ts:1828 records "authority receipt gate passed". Runtime confirmation: node --input-type=module import of buildCapabilityList() reports productionDoneRequiresReceipt=true and server.receiptVerify.status="available". This leaves an active CLI/runtime product model where Authority-style receipt verification is still the productionDone path, contradicting B-576e replacement semantics of local proof admissibility, signed/offline receipt bundles, and local review quorum.
